jobs.description:
Some people watch the game.Some people sing along when the music starts.Some people come to Kelly's Pub because they're craving a great burger and a cold drink.And then there are the people who make all of that happen.
 

We're looking for enthusiastic students or flexi-workers to join the Kelly's Pub family in Antwerp.
 

 
 

Welcome to Kelly's Pub
 

Kelly's Pub is the ultimate playground for sports lovers, music fans and anyone looking for great food, good drinks and unforgettable nights.
 

From nail-biting football matches and packed terraces to live music and late-night celebrations, there's always something happening. That's exactly what makes working here so much fun. No two shifts are ever the same.
 

 
 

What will you be doing?
 

You'll be one of the faces of Kelly's Pub and help create the atmosphere our guests keep coming back for.
 

 
 

Your mission includes:
 
 

• Welcoming guests with a smile 

• Advising customers on food and drinks 

• Taking orders and serving food and beverages 

• Clearing and resetting tables 

• Keeping an eye on your guests and making sure they have everything they need 

• Helping create the unforgettable Kelly's Pub experience  

 
 

Because at Kelly's Pub, we're not just serving drinks. We're serving good times.

What do we expect?
 

* You speak fluent English (our main language within the team)
 

* Additional languages are always a bonus
 

* You're available to work on 31 December, the biggest and most exciting night of the year
 

* You're eager to join us before and after the holiday season as well
 

* You enjoy working where the action happens

• Assist with staging, deployment and lifecycle management activities across the EndPoint landscape

• Share knowledge with colleagues and actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

• 3+ years of experience in Windows EndPoint Management

• Strong troubleshooting skills within Microsoft Windows environments

• Hands-on experience with SCCM / MECM

jobs.description:

For one of our clients, a leading international player in the financial sector based in Brussels, Digitribe is looking for a senior Transformation Lead with a strong Lean and Continuous Improvement background. You will lead end-to-end transformation initiatives, help business teams rethink how they work, and make sure the change lasts.
Your role

• Lead complex transformation initiatives from scoping to delivery, with clear objectives, disciplined execution and measurable outcomes

• Apply Lean and continuous improvement methods (value stream mapping, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, process re-engineering) to redesign processes and services

• Structure complex cross-functional problems: diagnose root causes, challenge assumptions and align stakeholders on pragmatic target-state options

• Push business domains beyond incremental optimisation towards different ways of working where the value justifies it

• Define target operating models, covering roles and responsibilities, governance, controls, KPIs and management routines

• Identify automation and AI opportunities with IT, data and architecture teams, always tied to business value and adoption

• Embed risk, compliance, auditability and control requirements in a highly regulated environment from the start

• Build transformation roadmaps, transition states and business requirements, and drive benefit realisation through value hypotheses and KPIs

• Coach team members and business teams in Lean, problem-solving and facilitation so they can keep improving on their own

• Improve reusable methods, templates and playbooks to keep delivery consistent across initiatives

What makes you successful

You are comfortable with ambiguity and know how to bring structure and momentum to it. You are pragmatic and delivery-driven, empathetic, and you earn trust at every level. You lead from the front while empowering others, and you see yourself as a role model for continuous improvement.

• Master's degree or equivalent experience

• 10+ years of experience combining consulting with operational transformation or line-management roles

• Proven track record leading process re-engineering, service redesign or operating model transformation

• Strong hands-on Lean expertise and experience coaching others in it. Lean Six Sigma certification (Green/Black Belt) is a plus

• Familiarity with Agile principles

• Solid consulting toolkit: structured problem solving, hypothesis-driven analysis, workshop facilitation and executive communication

• Interest in AI, automation and data, with good judgment on feasibility, risk and adoption

• Experience in regulated, control-heavy environments. Financial services experience is a strong asset

• Excellent English (written and spoken). French and/or Dutch is a plus

Your RoleReporting directly to the HR Director, you will act as an all-round HR Generalist driving our "soft HR" strategy across the organization. You will take ownership of defined projects with clear milestones and deliverables to streamline HR operations and cultivate a healthy, open workplace culture.
Beyond initial design, your core focus will be the practical rollout, end-to-end implementation, and continuous follow-up of essential HR processes, ensuring that initiatives like onboarding, performance management, and learning & development don't just exist on paper, but are actively adopted, monitored, and sustained across all teams.
This is an ideal role for a pragmatic HR professional with the drive and capacity to step up into a senior HR leadership position as Fanfinity expands.
 
 

• End-to-end Recruitment: Together with colleagues in the HR team, independently manage a selected portfolio of vacancies: from crafting engaging role profiles, screening CVs, conducting interviews, and securing top talent to match our growth pace. 

• New Hire Onboarding: Take personal ownership of the soft landing for your newly placed hires running structured check-ins and follow-ups to ensure a smooth integration. 

• Performance Management: Roll out, manage, and actively follow up on the performance management cycle, guiding managers and employees through goal-setting, continuous feedback habits, structured performance reviews and guide team leads through yearly wage review cycle. 

• Learning & Development: Identify organizational skill gaps, design practical development pathways, coordinate targeted training initiatives, and follow up on employee growth plans to foster continuous internal upskilling. 

• Trusted Advisory: Act as an approachable, trusted partner for employees and managers alike, offering practical guidance on day-to-day people topics while embedding a company-wide culture of open feedback, mutual trust, and transparent communication. 

• Employee Engagement & Retention: Drive initiatives that boost team morale, monitor employee sentiment, and execute proactive retention strategies across our departments. 

What You BringMust-Have Requirements:
 
 

• Proven Experience: Minimum of 3 years of relevant HR generalist experience, with demonstrable hands-on experience in recruitment, performance management and/or learning & development. 

• Languages: Full professional fluency in both Dutch and English (spoken and written); comfortable interviewing candidates, advising leadership, drafting documentation, and holding sensitive discussions in both languages. 

• Implementation & Follow-Up Track Record: Proven ability to not just design HR workflows, but to roll them out, ensure manager and team adoption, and maintain systematic follow-up. 

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or equivalent practical experience. 

• Project Delivery: Demonstrated capability to manage defined HR projects independently and hit clear milestones and deliverables.  

Who You Are:
 
 

• Hands-On & Pragmatic: You enjoy rolling up your sleeves to implement solutions. 

• Proactive & Autonomous: You find it stimulating to spot an inefficient workflow, devise a structured fix, and drive it through to complete execution without micro-management. 

• Strong Communicator: You build trust quickly, navigate difficult conversations with empathy, and know how to rally managers around new HR initiatives. 

• Growth-Oriented: You bring intellectual curiosity, high emotional intelligence, and the leadership potential required to step into a senior HR role as the company scales.

VG458/BUOSAP

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver | Full-Time | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
As a CE Truck Driver, you start your day from the company's site in Horebeke with a refrigerated truck loaded with fresh potato products. You'll follow a planned route and deliver goods to distribution centres, wholesalers and retail customers, making for an average of about 8 stops per day. As a CE Truck Driver, you are responsible for checking delivery documents, ensuring accurate deliveries and handling products with care. Loading and unloading is mainly done using an electric pallet truck, limiting heavy physical work. There’s occasional work on Saturdays, between 8 AM. and 5 PM, in which case you get a day off during the week. You work independently, take pride in maintaining your vehicle and follow a schedule that is communicated in advance.

 
We are looking for a CE Truck Driver who combines professionalism with a customer-oriented mindset. The ideal CE Truck Driver has:

 
• A valid CE driving license with a valid code 95 certification.
 
• Previous experience as a CE driver.
 
• Good communication skills in English, additional language skills are considered a plus.
 
• A responsible and independent attitude.
 
• A customer-friendly and professional approach.
 
• Flexibility regarding working hours when needed.
 
• Respect for safety procedures and company equipment.

As a production worker, you will be responsible for:

• Cutting and processing poultry

• Preparing products such as satay, sausages, and meatballs (BBQ)

• Packaging and inspecting products for quality

• Cleaning the workstation

• Helping out as needed on the production line

• Good knowledge of English, Polish or Romanian

• Works accurately and at a steady pace

• You’re not put off by colder environments

• Flexible start time (between 6 a.m. and 8 a.m.)

As a Technical Buyer, you will play a crucial role in driving procurement performance across long-term projects. Your primary focus will be identifying and realizing savings opportunities while building strong, strategic relationships with suppliers. You will challenge cost increases, perform market analyses, develop compelling business cases, and negotiate optimal commercial conditions.

Our client is an international supply chain specialist serving the automotive industry. The company manages the procurement and distribution of fastening solutions and technical components for leading manufacturers worldwide.

This position combines analytical problem-solving with stakeholder management and requires someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and market conditions continuously evolve.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze supplier price increase requests and assess their impact on procurement budgets.

• Conduct market research and benchmarking to validate pricing proposals and identify cost-saving opportunities.

• Develop and present fact-based business cases to support negotiations and purchasing decisions.

• Lead commercial discussions with suppliers and negotiate the best possible pricing and contractual conditions.

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing suppliers.

• Organize and participate in supplier performance reviews and business meetings.

• Monitor market trends and proactively identify risks and opportunities within the supply chain.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive procurement efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Manage purchasing activities for strategic, long-term projects from analysis through implementation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or a related field.

• 2 to 5 years of experience in purchasing, sourcing, procurement or a comparable commercial role.

• Proven experience in supplier negotiations and achieving measurable cost reductions.

• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills.

• Commercially driven with the confidence to challenge suppliers and defend your position using facts and data.

• Experience within a technical, manufacturing or automotive-related environment is considered a strong advantage.

• Familiarity with procurement terminology, sourcing methodologies and supplier management processes.

• Fluency in English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

You enjoy being present on the warehouse floor, taking ownership, and motivating people to achieve operational goals.

must haves
